user.title: Connect to gafctl
user.description: Enter the local address of the gafctl API.

device.title: Choose devices
device.description: Select the HTTP-owned devices to add. Each gets its own entry.

reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of the same gafctl proxy.

error.wrong_device: This address does not report the configured proxy and device.

abort.device_unavailable: The selected device is no longer available.
